messages.subject: Problem with geom_bar
parts:
Hello,

How to avoid these errors?

> dput(g)
structure(list(vvkk = structure(c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L), .Label =
c("2009 11",
"2009 12", "2010 01"), class = "factor"), tume = structure(c(1L,
2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), .Label = c("meno", "tulo"), class = "factor"),
summ = c(18440.1, 14312.27, 3122.35, 4236.15, 3228.32, 3657.9

2.10.1. The reason was that library memisc masked rename function from
the reshape package:
